import pandas as pd

# Read the intermediate result after the group_by and sum aggregation operation
intermediate_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_35/intermediate_step1.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(intermediate_path)

# Ensure the column types match the target schema: 'Source Zipcode' as integer, 'Counts' as integer
df['Source Zipcode'] = df['Source Zipcode'].astype(int)
df['Counts'] = df['Counts'].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source table with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# Group by 'Source Zipcode' and sum 'Counts'
result = source1.groupby("Source Zipcode", as_index=False)["Counts"].sum()

# Write output to target file with exact column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
